audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows were wrong. Level 1 read Skill while whys[0] opens 'You own Level 1'; Level 2 read Illaoi while whys[1] opens 'Even stage'; 4-5 read Skill while whys[3] says 'she owns this stretch'; 2+ items read Illaoi while whys[6] and spikes[3] both say teamfights flip to Maokai. Level 6 read Skill and 'even', which is the one row where the prose itself was wrong.
audit.why: Levels 4-5 and 6 are hers because the tentacle field compounds and Leap of Faith spawns a tentacle per champion hit; the two ends of the lane are Maokai's because she has one weak tentacle at level 1 and because R plus W drag her off her terrain in a 5v5. The mirror audit set Level 1 to Maokai, 4-5 and 6 to Illaoi and 2+ items to Maokai — I matched all four and added Level 2 to Skill, which both the packet chart and this page's own whys[1] already called even.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Maokai / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Maokai as one atomic group of matched full+content pairs, ratings moved with it, and whys[4] rewritten so the level-6 row is no longer described as even.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 row claimed Illaoi's ultimate is a 'tentacle wall' that 'matches you'.
audit.why: Leap of Faith is not a wall — Riot's text is that she smashes her idol for damage and 'a Tentacle spawns for each enemy champion hit'. That is why 6 is her spike and not an even stage: the ult permanently grows the thing that already beats you.
audit.corrected: Written into whys[4] and phases[4].why with the real mechanic, and the 120s cooldown into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Harsh Lesson is never named or numbered anywhere on the page, and the whole lane is built around tracking Test of Spirit instead.
audit.why: Harsh Lesson is a 4-second, 400-range dash that makes every nearby tentacle swing at the target it hits. At a 4s cooldown it is effectively always available, so the real rule is positional — never stand beside a tentacle — not a cooldown count. Test of Spirit at 16s is the one worth actually tracking, and the page tracks it without ever giving the number.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with Test of Spirit at 16s / 900 range, Harsh Lesson at 4s / 400 range with the always-up instruction, and Leap of Faith at 120s. Harsh Lesson also written into phases[1].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said that Sap Magic's cooldown shortens each time an enemy spell strikes Maokai.
audit.why: It cuts against the page's flat 'never brawl in her field' advice in a useful way: her slams do pay for part of the healing that lets him survive them, which is why the anti-heal item is aimed at HER sustain rather than being a general purchase. The mirror audit called this the most important missing interaction on the matchup.
audit.corrected: Not written into prose this pass — every candidate field was already at its length ceiling with higher-value corrections. Recorded here and in notes so it is not lost.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood and its three copies refer to Illaoi as 'his answer' and 'his every path'.
audit.why: Wrong-pronoun boilerplate on a champion the rest of the page correctly calls 'her'.
audit.corrected: tradeGood rewritten in her pronouns and keyed to Test of Spirit and the tentacle she just planted.

edits.before: Passive heal + AA trades carry the early waves. Identify how Illaoi contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours: one tentacle, no field, and Harsh Lesson only reaches 400. Step up and contest the wave while she is slow.

edits.before: W root is your engage AND your peel — spend it once per fight. Only take the trade when Illaoi's Test of Spirit is down.
edits.after: Skill stage: your W-Q is real, but Harsh Lesson is a 4s dash that calls every nearby tentacle. Trade away from her terrain.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Test of Spirit's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Hers: with the field stacked, stepping into your own casters to last-hit is a slam plus a 900-range Test of Spirit you cannot win.

edits.before: Nature’s Grasp roots whole teams — lane it only for kill windows. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Illaoi's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Leap of Faith spawns a tentacle for every champion it hits, so 6 grows her field instead of yours. Your R is gank setup, not a duel.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Illaoi carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on you take it back through utility: R roots her out of her own field and W drags her off the spot she is monstrous on.

edits.before: - Illaoi Test of Spirit: matchup-defining — Her vessel pull. Sidestep it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Illaoi Test of Spirit: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1, 900 range. Step up only after she throws it. - Harsh Lesson is 4s and 400 range: assume it is always up and never stand next to a tentacle. - Leap of Faith: 120s.

edits.before: W-root Illaoi the moment his answer is down, Q-knockback the follow-up, and let brush saplings tax his every path.
edits.after: W-root her once Test of Spirit is spent, Q-knock her off the tentacle she just planted, and sapling her terrain.

edits.before: Even at 6 — your R is engage utility not a 1v1 spike, and her ult tentacle wall matches you, so it comes down to who pulls who off their spot.
edits.after: Six is hers — Leap of Faith spawns a tentacle for every champion it hits, so it grows the field, while my R is engage utility rather than a duel button.

notes: packet.suspectNames flags 'Land Test of Spirit' in wants.foe[1] as a probable wrong name. False positive — Test of Spirit is her real E and the string is correct; the matcher scored the leading verb. One genuinely valuable interaction I could not verify and therefore wrote nothing about: Illaoi's passive spawns tentacles 'on nearby impassible terrain', and Nature's Grasp is described in the kit as creating terrain. If the bramble wall counts as impassible terrain for her passive, ulting near her would hand her free tentacles — which would invert the level-6 and teamfight advice on this page. See questionsForUser. Also unwritten for want of space: Sap Magic's cooldown shortening when her spells strike you.
